title: Respect at Work and Other Matters Amendment Act 2024
version_kind: as passed; the Act is not in the in-force collection on the retrieval date
converter: qld_convert.py (Legalese Commons scratch script, Python 3.12 html.parser; not kept in the repository)
conversion: HTML 'whole' view to UTF-8 plain text: Chapter/Part/Division/Schedule headings kept as tab-indented lines ('Part 1 — Name'); sections as '<number><TAB><heading>'; paragraph numbers kept; tables one row per line as '| a | b |'; amendment-history notes (class view-history-note), links, scripts and site chrome removed; attribution and unofficial-version notice prepended.
note: An amending Act, deposited as passed (published 2024-09-19); it is not in the in-force collection. Part 2 amends the Anti-Discrimination Act 1991. The provisions due on 1 December 2024 are in the current 1991 Act; those due on 1 July 2025 (for example new ss 10-11, the positive duty in chapter 5C and the prohibition of harassment on the basis of sex) are not in the 1991 Act version in force from 2025-05-19, current on 2026-11-06, and the 1991 Act's s 285AA refers to s 7B of this Act, so the commencement of those provisions has been deferred or changed by later legislation not deposited here. The register holds no separate Anti-Discrimination Act 2024 or Anti-Discrimination Bill 2024.
